verdict.rationale: smolagents documents autonomous multi-step agent runs (`agent.run`, `max_steps`, planning intervals, step-by-step execution for long tool calls), but these are one-off invocations a developer starts in code. Nothing in the evidence shows a product feature for setting up recurring, scheduled, triggered or background automations. Step-by-step execution and the CLI are building blocks a developer would have to wrap in their own scheduler, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
